body_es: Elegir la métrica correcta es crucial para evaluar realmente el desempeño de modelos. Para regresión, aprenderás MAE, RMSE y R². Para clasificación, usarás precisión, recall, F1-score y matrices de confusión. La curva ROC y AUC miden capacidad discriminativa. Comprenderás la diferencia entre desempeño en entrenamiento y prueba, identificando overfitting y underfitting. Las métricas deben alinearse con objetivos de negocio. Aprenderás a reportar resultados honestamente y evitar optimizar métricas que no importan verdaderamente.
body_en: Choosing correct metric crucial for truly evaluating model performance. For regression, you'll learn MAE, RMSE and R². For classification, use precision, recall, F1-score and confusion matrices. ROC curve and AUC measure discriminative ability. You'll understand difference between training and test performance, identifying overfitting and underfitting. Metrics should align with business objectives. You'll learn to report results honestly and avoid optimizing metrics that don't truly matter.
